title: eupatorium cordatum var. fraseri
intro: Eupatorium cordatum var. fraseri, commonly known as Joe-Pye weed, is a perennial plant native to North America, belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues due to its various health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Eupatorium cordatum var. fraseri are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antipyretic properties, which help in soothing pain and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
